title: First Gameplay of my AI-powered RPG - the world reacts to YOUR words
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Here’s the first real gameplay of my experimental RPG where players can create world content with their own words.

The world reacts to text prompts and evolves based on player decisions - I’m still exploring how far this can go.

I’d really love feedback on two things:
– Does the concept feel interesting / clear from the clip?
– Any thoughts on whether this is a good way to present the gameplay?

Here’s the Steam page if you want to check it out: https://theflairgame.com/on-steam?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gameplaytrailer&utm_content=aigamedev
(A wishlist would genuinely help a lot, if you like the idea <3)

comments.author: E_den
comments.body: If you can spawn anything you want, wouldn't this be closer then a sandbox game than a rpg ? Is there any sense of progression

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: That’s a really good question! I‘m actually not really sure yet but I already noticed there is some Kind of Core Gameplay Loop missing. That’s Fine because I will add many gameplay Loops in the Future and my Game is Designed in a way that makes many different Game modes possible like for example Battle Royale or a Zone System with npc Spawning

replies.author: E_den
replies.body:
Maybe you should figure it out before advertising it lol, right now this just doesn't look fun at all
The yellow filter is really not nice to look at either

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Thank You for your honest Feedback. This is a huge and complex project and I‘m trying to get some Feedback if people even like this new Type of Game

comments.author: agarlington
comments.body: this was fun to playtest for you man! keep it up

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Thank you so much :)) you are always welcome!
